jobs.title: Research Methodologist
jobs.reason: Survey methodology at Pew Research Center is policy-adjacent but outside the candidate's core IR/security/intelligence focus. The role requires strong proficiency in R (the candidate uses Python/SPSS, not R) and 3-5 years of professional experience with probability-based complex survey designs, which the candidate's student-assistant background does not meet. Two scores at 2 trigger Low.

jobs.title: IMS Auditor
jobs.reason: This is an ISO management systems auditor role requiring IRCA Lead Auditor registration, an environmental science/engineering degree, and substantial third-party auditing experience — none of which the candidate has. Hard mismatch on field (industrial compliance auditing) and specialist certification requirements.

jobs.title: Freelance Auditor (Food) Packaging Germany
jobs.reason: This is a food/packaging industry auditor role requiring a degree in packaging or food technology plus specialist quality-management qualifications (ISO 9001, BRC, IFS, FSSC 22000) — entirely unrelated to the candidate's IR/policy background. Hard mismatch across field, skills, and required vocational expertise.

jobs.title: Freelance Auditor (Food) Packaging Belgium
jobs.reason: This is a food/packaging industry auditor role requiring specialist qualifications in packaging or food technology and experience in quality management standards (ISO 9001, BRC, FSSC 22000) — entirely outside the candidate's IR/policy/research background. Specialist technical certifications the candidate cannot substitute for.

jobs.title: Surveyor
jobs.reason: This is a technical industrial inspection role requiring a mechanical/materials engineering background, 3+ years of experience in quality/inspection, and specialist knowledge of welding, pressure equipment, and regulations (PED/ASME/UKCA). Complete mismatch with the candidate's IR/policy profile, and specialist technical skills cannot be substituted.

jobs.title: Senior Surveyor
jobs.reason: Complete mismatch — this is a mechanical/metallurgy engineering inspection role requiring a Bachelor's in Mechanical/Metallurgy/Production Engineering, 10+ years of experience, and NDE Level-II qualifications. Multiple hard ineligibility triggers (specialist engineering credentials the candidate lacks; 10-year hard experience requirement).

jobs.title: IATF Lead Auditor
jobs.reason: Complete mismatch — this is an automotive quality management systems auditor role requiring mandatory IATF 16949 Lead Auditor certification and substantial third-party audit experience, none of which the candidate has. Hard ineligibility on specialist certification and required years of audit experience.

jobs.title: LECTURER.2.01 (AC.08.4)
jobs.reason: This is a nursing lecturer post requiring a Master's in Nursing and multiple South African Nursing Council registrations (Nurse, Midwife, Nurse Educator, Assessor/Moderator) — clinical credentials the candidate does not hold. Hard ineligibility on professional licence requirements.

jobs.title: AI and Machine Learning Advisor
jobs.reason: An "Advisor" role in AI/ML implies specialist technical expertise and seniority that the candidate does not have — their Python and data analysis skills are at research-assistant level, not advisory ML practitioner level. Field alignment is weak unless the role is specifically about AI policy/governance, which the title does not suggest. Insufficient detail provided, but on the face of it this is not a fit.

jobs.title: Account Manager - Healthcare & Life Sciences
jobs.reason: Healthcare/life sciences communications and public affairs is outside the candidate's core target zones (IR, security, geopolitical risk, OSINT/tech policy). The role also requires prior account management experience in healthcare comms, which the candidate lacks, and "Account Manager" sits above entry level. Two scores at 2 trigger a Low rating.

jobs.title: Senior Resource Manager (Creative, Strategy & Client Service)
jobs.reason: This is a senior resource management role within a Brand & Comms function — operational staffing/capacity management for creative and client service teams, unrelated to the candidate's IR/policy/intelligence targets. The "Senior" title also implies substantial prior resource management experience the candidate does not have.

jobs.title: Data Insight Officer
jobs.reason: This is a fundraising data analytics role focused on Power BI, SQL, Microsoft Dynamics CRM, and predictive modelling for charity income — not policy, research, or intelligence work. The candidate lacks the core required toolset (Power BI, SQL, advanced Excel/Power Query, dashboarding experience) and the role is squarely in commercial fundraising analytics rather than humanitarian policy research.

jobs.title: Intern, PGA
jobs.reason: Public affairs consulting is policy-adjacent rather than core to the candidate's IR/security/international law focus, and the client portfolio (energy, tech, healthcare, F&B) is broader commercial PR rather than geopolitical risk. However, the research, political monitoring, briefing-drafting and stakeholder mapping tasks map well onto the candidate's research/writing background, and the internship level fits their stage cleanly.
